newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish December trade surplus 2.509 bln Dkk.
newsitem.headline: Danish December trade surplus 2.509 bln Dkk.

text.p: Denmark's December trade surplus was 2.509 billion crowns excluding ships, the national statistics office said on Wednesday.
The December figure compared with a revised November surplus, excluding ships, of 2.550 billion crowns and a 1.742-billion crown surplus in December 1995, the office said

Seasonally adjusted, the surplus excluding ships, for December 1996 was 3.188 billion crowns against a revised 1.765 billion crown surplus in November and a 1.790 billion crowns surplus in December 1995.
Denmark's preliminary 1996 unadjusted trade surplus excluding ships rose to 31.105 billion crowns from a revised 27.487 billion crown surplus in 1995.
NOTE - Analysts polled by Reuters predicted an average December trade surplus excluding ships of 1.8 billion crowns and 2.0 billion crowns seasonally adjusted.
